selection_rules: capture -> MAA (36x faster than ADB, verified)
known-ROI template match -> legacy OpenCV fixed-ROI (3.3x faster than MAA full-frame)
unknown-position full-frame search -> MAA (legacy fixed-ROI cannot do it)
click / swipe / key -> MAA controller native channel
OCR -> RapidOCR on a dedicated ROI (MAA has no OCR model)
complex semantics / unknown page -> Qwen only after rules, templates, OCR and experience fail
one primary + at most one fallback per capability class - no tool sprawl
